data.title: Guru's daily horoscope for Aug 14
data.description: The day of the week you were born on can reveal a lot... Read on.

data.title: The Bangkok Post launches premium digital subscription to support next phase of digital growth
data.description: The Bangkok Post will introduce its premium digital subscription on Aug 14, 2026, signalling the next phase of its digital strategy as it scales reader revenue alongside print, Epaper and advertising operations.

data.title: Chaichanok faces TH-AI subpoena
data.description: <p>The House budget monitoring committee may compel Digital Economy and Society Minister Chaichanok Chidchob to testify over the TH-AI Passport project after he failed to appear before the panel for a fourth time.</p>

data.title: House panel targets alleged Thai citizenship fraud
data.description: A House committee has urged authorities to dismantle a suspected transnational network that allegedly used Thai men as fake fathers to help children born to Chinese parents fraudulently obtain Thai citizenship.

data.title: Fit Patrik ready to fire War Elephants
data.description: Thailand head coach Anthony Hudson welcomed the addition of striker Patrik Gustavsson, saying the BG Pathum United star will give the team an attacking option in the first leg of the Asean Hyundai Cup semi-finals on Saturday.

data.title: Chaichana reports to police over 'assault'
data.description: Democrat Party deputy leader and Nakhon Si Thammarat MP Chaichana Detdecho reported to police on Thursday to acknowledge an assault charge and give a statement over an alleged physical confrontation with a senior police officer at a funeral.

data.title: US agrees to boost defence cooperation
data.description: <p>Thailand and the United States have reaffirmed their 193-year alliance, underscoring their commitment to strengthening modern security cooperation to address emerging security challenges.</p>

data.title: Israel reopens once-closed West Bank settlement
data.description: GANIM (PALESTINIAN TERRITORIES) - Israel officially reopened the West Bank settlement of Ganim on Thursday, more than 20 years after it withdrew from the community, in a move emblematic of the current government's policy of rapid settlement expansion.

data.title: Indicted Raul Castro reappears after months out of public view
data.description: HAVANA - US-indicted Cuban leader Raul Castro received a standing ovation as he appeared in public for the first time in months Thursday, attending an event in Havana to mark the centenary of his brother Fidel's birth.

data.title: 'Dream come true': Owners reunite with pets in quake-hit Colombia
data.description: CALI (COLOMBIA) - A beaming Vickye Giraldo holds her rescued kitten tight against her chest outside her ruined home in quake-hit Cali, Colombia.

data.title: Twitch sparks gamers' wrath with Amazon AI sharing deal
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Livestream gaming giant Twitch has raised hackles among its millions of users after declaring it will share their data with its parent company Amazon, to better train the online retailer's AI models.

data.title: 'If you can, move!' say Rome's viral dancing seniors
data.description: ROME - Bopping to Michael Jackson and Elvis Presley in a Roman square, an elderly dancing duo has become a viral sensation in Italy -- something they hope will inspire other seniors to take up a more active lifestyle.

data.title: Japanese tourist injured in robbery near Bangkok Airport Rail Link station
data.description: A 43-year-old Japanese tourist was injured by a group of suspected robbers near Makkasan station on the Bangkok Airport Rail Link on Wednesday night, police said.

data.title: Blaze forces families to abandon Turkish tour boat
data.description: ISTANBUL — More than 100 people had to abandon ship after a fire engulfed a children's entertainment tour boat off southwestern Turkey on Thursday, officials said.

data.title: Household power bills to fall from Sept 1
data.description: Household electricity bills have been poised to fall from September after regulators approved a new tariff structure that removes public street-lighting costs from residential bills and caps the rate for the first 200 units of monthly consumption at no more than 3 baht per unit.

data.title: ERC confirms lower power bills from Sep
data.description: Household electricity bills have been poisted to fall from September after regulators approved a new tariff structure that removes public street-lighting costs from residential bills and caps the rate for the first 200 units of monthly consumption at no more than 3 baht per unit.

data.title: 'How many will die?': the mysterious ailment killing Kenyan elephants
data.description: KIMANA (KENYA) - Lying on the ground and kicking up a cloud of dust, an elephant slowly exhausts himself in a futile attempt to stand, the latest potential victim of a still-mysterious ailment in southern Kenya.

data.title: Maghreb sees demographic shift with fertility at historic low
data.description: TUNIS - Economic pressures and changing social norms are driving couples in Tunisia, Morocco, and Algeria to have fewer babies, with a recent study saying Maghreb fertility was at a historic low.

data.title: Policeman caught smoking meth during online training
data.description: PHATTHALUNG: An investigation has been launched after a police officer was allegedly caught using methamphetamine during an online training session attended by hundreds of fellow officers.

data.title: Cobra Gold 2027 ‘to proceed as planned’
data.description: Thailand and the United States will proceed with the Cobra Gold 2027 military exercises according to the original plan, a spokesman for the Ministry of Defence said on Thursday.

data.title: Romania shuts down nuclear plant as Danube drops
data.description: BUCHAREST - Romania halted operations of its only nuclear plant on Thursday, a rare shutdown due to a drought scorching Europe that has caused the Danube river, whose waters cool the plant, to fall to record lows.

data.title: Court acquits actress Pinky in Forex-3D Ponzi case
data.description: The Criminal Court on Thursday acquitted actress Savika “Pinky” Chaiyadej, her mother and her elder brother in the high-profile Forex-3D investment fraud case, while sentencing Forex-3D founder Apiruk Kothi and four other defendants to lengthy prison terms.

data.title: US ambassador denounces ‘thuggish’ Israeli settlers
data.description: QUSRA, Palestinian Territories - Israeli forces on Thursday moved against rogue settlers who have besieged Palestinians amid unusually strong US criticism, even as Israel inaugurated a major settlement elsewhere in the West Bank.
